jesus.name: Jesus Christ
jesus.role: Son of the Father, whose teaching the elder urges readers to keep
jesus.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
jesus.importance: The elder names grace, mercy, and peace from the Lord Jesus Christ. He warns of deceivers who do not confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. Anyone who stays in Christ’s teaching has both the Father and the Son.
jesus.connections: The elder calls him the Son of the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

word.languageNote: This is the dictionary form of the name “Christ.”
